newsitem.title: USA: Vastar says finds gas at 3 South Texas wells.
newsitem.headline: Vastar says finds gas at 3 South Texas wells.

text.p: Vastar Resources Inc said it struck natural gas at three of its South Texas wells.
The company said its Frost-McLean well in Jim Hogg County offsetting the Thompsonville field produced 10 million cubic feet of natural gas per day (MMcfd) from the deepest of its two zones.
The company also said its Christensen 1 well in the Clay West field in Live Oak County has been tested at a rate of seven MMcfd.
It said its Houston Gas Unit 6 well near the Donna field in Hildago County is flowing at a rate of five MMcfd.
All three wells were drilled based on 3D seismic, the company said.
